view-01.png.evidence: Bright radial explosion has layered sparks and colored bloom; intricate mechanical surfaces and atmospheric cliffs give depth, though crowded silhouettes near blast lose separation.

view-02.png.evidence: Buttons and aircraft silhouettes are clear, but flat beige carrier lacks structure, sea is broad blurry blue cells, and central objective text overlaps deck.

view-03.png.evidence: Top objective bars separate text from play; deck structures and teal wave streaks add detail, but crowded identical aircraft and soft dot particles obscure the player.

view-04.png.evidence: Uncluttered deck and top objective bars read clearly; tower and edge rails add form while sea, deck and wake remain softly rendered and weakly lit.

view-05.png.evidence: Wet ground reflections, smoke columns, rain and orange projectile lighting create convincing atmosphere; dark small troops and gray vehicles are difficult to separate at this size.

view-06.png.evidence: Aircraft have clear cream/red silhouettes and dark shadows; carrier structures help depth, while repeating watery streaks and flat material shading limit realism.

view-07.png.evidence: Sharper deck rail edges and aircraft markings combine with scattered sea highlights; white flecks give surface activity but look detached from broad waves.

view-08.png.evidence: Fields and runway are easy to identify, but repetitive checker grass and simple faceted trees look schematic; floating labels crowd the plane and shoreline.

view-09.png.evidence: Market stalls have distinct produce, wood, stone and fabric with consistent cast shadows; thin colored route lines remain visible despite densely packed figures.

view-10.png.evidence: Cream aircraft and outlined controls are crisp; white water flecks add variation, but featureless beige carrier and overlapping yellow label reduce environmental finish.

view-11.png.evidence: Deck stripes, rails and superstructure read clearly with restrained top HUD; sparse foam flecks and wake add interest, though materials stay flat.

view-12.png.evidence: Runway markings and coastline are readable; grass pattern is noisy and buildings are plain pale squares, with objective label crossing the central aircraft.

view-13.png.evidence: Quiet carrier composition and clear controls aid scanning; broad tan deck is nearly unmodeled and bright floating sea fragments feel more decorative than physical.

view-14.png.evidence: Cutaway rooms show coherent warm/cool light, wall depth, wood grain, tiled baths and furniture; small tactical marks stay legible against varied surfaces.

view-15.png.evidence: Objective bars are legible; runway has hangar forms and perimeter detail, trees have soft grounding shadows, but fields and grass are blurred and nearly uniform.

view-16.png.evidence: Clean objective bars and sharpened runway details improve hierarchy; rounded tree shadows ground objects while sparse sea glints remain shallow and repetitive.

view-17.png.evidence: Layered fog, varied autumn vegetation, road ruts and weathered shed create rich depth; flashes and smoke integrate well, though gray tanks blend into terrain.

view-18.png.evidence: Runway, three hangars and roadway form a coherent base; subtle tree shadows help height, but broad grass and roof planes show little material variation.

view-19.png.evidence: Sharper aircraft outlines and carrier detail survive crowding; whitecaps and sparks enrich the surface, but stacked planes and translucent dots obscure center action.

view-20.png.evidence: Dense ring of repeated aircraft hides carrier edges and central player; yellow objective overlaps action, with soft dots and flat ocean providing little depth.

view-21.png.evidence: Runway is clearly shaped but three buildings are blank squares; coarse grass and minimal shadows flatten the land, and yellow objective overlays the aircraft.

view-22.png.evidence: Field rectangles and faceted trees provide landmarks; broad blue water and patterned grass are flat, and central labels compete with small plane.

view-23.png.evidence: Single carrier and large buttons read easily; beige deck is almost featureless, water is blurred cellular color, and wake is a simple pale streak.

view-24.png.evidence: Crisp hangar frames, runway edging and markings support clear geography; tree shading and scattered sea glints add depth without detailed material response.

view-25.png.evidence: Sharper aircraft and white water flecks add surface activity, but dense aircraft swarm, soft sparks and overlaid objective text obscure the carrier center.

top3_gaps: Most aircraft/coastal frames have flat large surfaces: stronger directional illumination, contact shadow and distinguishable deck/roof/soil material response are needed.
Crowded aircraft and center-position objective labels compete with the player; maintain silhouette separation and text hierarchy in busy scenes.
Ocean flecks, wakes and spark dots need more coherent scale, shape and integration; currently many read as detached decoration.
_summary.blinding_limitations: No outside files or mapping inspected. Several images visibly share the same aircraft/carrier game and HUD, so family grouping is apparent. Five images depict much more detailed distinct tactical or battlefield scenes; visual style makes cross-family identity obvious, but no exact source titles or iteration mapping used.
